Everything said about install and verification in the linux-25689360 record applies here unchanged: no anonymous boot (an operator Funcom self-hosting token is required), no `takaro-maint install` seam for the image bundle, and `verification.required` stays `contract` with runtime proof recorded on the dev rig.

notes: One pinned Node image serves both halves of the build: the sidecar is TypeScript, and node:*-bookworm (not slim) carries the g++ the LD_PRELOAD plugin needs, on the same glibc 2.36 as the Funcom server image — a plugin built on anything newer would fail to preload. The server itself is not run from this image: it is Funcom's own seabass-server image, loaded out of the depot above and tagged 2156652-0-shipping. The game client is a different Steam app (1172710) and is not pinned here; the public client of 2026-10-20 (build 25936403) joins this build.
